subject: Post-demo: Decision onramp, legal kickoff & champion talking points
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + immediate next steps

Hi Asha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our demo and a few concrete asks so we can keep momentum: 

1) Decision criteria (what we heard)
   - Latency SLA: under 200ms p95 for the fraud-detection flow
   - Data isolation: VPC/Private deployment option required for prod
   - Unit economics: target token cost < $0.0008 for inference pipeline

2) Immediate asks (can you confirm?):
   - Economic buyer / final approver for this purchase
   - Security contact(s) who will own SOC2 / pen test review
   - Procurement contact for timeline + PO/contract process

3) Proposed next steps
   - Intro from you to Procurement + Security so we can share tailored artifacts
   - We’ll send a one-page ROI for execs and a short SOC2 evidence summary
   - 30-min legal/ops kickoff next week to align on contract/DSA scope

I attached two items that should help the internal threads: RWI-decision-onramp.pdf (one-pager on decision lanes + technical fit) and procurement-checklist.xlsx (shows typical procurement gating items and timelines).

Would you be able to introduce Diego in procurement and Priya in security this week? If so, Ben and I will set up the invite and share the artifacts ahead of time.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0128

Attachments: RWI-decision-onramp.pdf (PDF, 1 page), procurement-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@novacorp.com>, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + immediate next steps

Thanks Marissa — nice recap and the attachments are useful. Quick answers and a couple notes: 

- Economic buyer / approver: Diego Ramos (cc’d) — Head of Cloud Platforms. He will own budget and final sign-off.
- Security: Priya Shah (sec lead) will own SOC2 and technical reviews — I’ll loop her in separately.
- Procurement: procurement@novacorp.com handles SOW/PO and vendor onboarding. Typical timeline is 4–6 weeks once we share standard contract + security artifacts.

Two requests from our side: 
1) Could you send a concise ROI one-pager (metrics + payback assumptions) aimed at Diego? He likes clear numbers and a comparison to current infra spend.
2) Do you have a SOC2 evidence summary or a short note that lists what artifacts we’ll provide for review? A link or a one-page would be great.

I’m available Thursday 9–11am PT for a quick legal/procurement intro call; otherwise Friday afternoon works. I’ll wait for your intro to Priya and procurement.

Appreciate the fast follow-up — Asha

Asha Menon
Director, Data Platforms
Novacorp
asha.menon@novacorp.com
+1 212-555-0987

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@novacorp.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + immediate next steps

On Wed, Jul 14, 2027 at 3:22 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Asha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our demo and a few concrete asks so we can keep momentum: 

Thanks — looping Ben in for the ROI one-pager and security artifacts. I drafted a short exec-friendly ROI/impact talk track below that we can tailor for Novacorp: 

- Headline: Reduce inference unit cost by ~35% vs current GPU-hosted baseline (3–6 month payback on pilot uplift)
- Metricized bullets: 
  * Baseline: $0.0021/token (current managed infra)
  * Projected with Redwood: $0.00135/token (batching + quantized models)
  * Pilot plan: 8-week sandbox with production-like throughput to validate p95 latency and cost
- Exec ask: Approval to run pilot (capacity-reserved) and authority to proceed with procurement after SOC2 review

Security artifacts we’ll share: SOC2 summary page, list of third-party audits, redacted pen-test report, and our data retention / deletion playbook. I’ll attach the SOC2 summary link and a small checklist for Priya to review.

Next actions (proposed):
- Marissa to intro Diego + Priya (Asha to confirm)
- Ben to send ROI one-pager + short appendix on assumptions (by EOD)
- Marissa & Karthik to propose two slots for legal/procurement kickoff (Thu 9–10am PT or Fri 2–3pm PT)

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 650-555-0199

Attachments: SOC2-summary-link.txt (link stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@novacorp.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@novacorp.com, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + immediate next steps

Thanks Asha & Diego — looping everyone in. 

Per Ben’s note I attached a tailored ROI one-pager (Novacorp_ROI_onepager_v1.pdf) that highlights the baseline comparison and the pilot success criteria Diego requested. Ben — please flag anything you want changed before I send this to Diego’s executive Slack channel.

I’ve proposed two slots for the legal/procurement kickoff: Thu 9–10am PT (tomorrow) or Fri 2–3pm PT. If neither works I can send a Doodle.

What I’ll bring to the kickoff: 
- Short runbook for procurement (attach procurement-checklist.xlsx)
- Pilot SOW template and proposed SLA language (we can leave redlines to Novacorp legal)
- SOC2 summary link and list of deliverables for Priya to start her review

Action items for Novacorp: please confirm which slot works and whether Diego wants an internal pre-brief with his execs (we can keep it to 10 minutes).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Novacorp_ROI_onepager_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
